```
Fix build-ffi.sh on macOS 27.0.1: leave host proc-macros unstripped

In a fresh target directory, scripts/build-ffi.sh failed with "can't
find crate for thiserror_impl". dyld refuses to load every host
proc-macro dylib on macOS 27.0.1: "mis-aligned LINKEDIT string pool".

The script exports MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=14.0, and the variable also
reaches host proc-macros and build scripts. At a 14.0 floor the linker
writes chained fixups. rustc then strips release dylibs with its bundled
rust-objcopy, which leaves the string table only 4-byte aligned, and
macOS 27.0.1 rejects that. The same dylib loads when unstripped or
stripped with /usr/bin/strip.

rustc reads the deployment target only from the environment, so RUSTFLAGS
or a link argument cannot limit it to the two cross targets. Instead set
CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_BUILD_OVERRIDE_STRIP=false so host proc-macros and
build scripts are not stripped.

The shipped static library is unchanged: every object in it still
targets macOS 14.0 on both architectures.
```
